title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration
summary: Hold: the high cost rating treats licensing for existing tools as a confirmed cost of the new admin-centre experience, whose licensing the briefing correctly says is unpublished. The claim that everything documented is script-driven also overlooks the documented Exchange admin center option for standalone mailbox migrations. The listed migration commands and their source-versus-target tenant instructions are supported.
